# vyos.blueprints.route_policy

Routing policy - access-lists, prefix-lists and route-maps

- Building block for route filtering used by the OSPF and BGP blueprints.
- Prefix-lists and route-maps use vyos.vyos.vyos_prefix_lists and vyos_route_maps; access-lists and route-map descriptions use vyos.vyos.vyos_config, because vyos.vyos has no access-list module and vyos_route_maps no route-map description yet.
- Run before the routing roles that reference these policies.

## Usage

```yaml
- hosts: routers
  gather_facts: false
  roles:
    - vyos.blueprints.route_policy
```

## Variables

| Variable | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `route_policy_access_lists` | list |  | `[]` | Numbered IPv4 access-lists (`policy access-list`). |
| `route_policy_access_lists.number` | int | yes |  | Access-list number, e.g. `150`. |
| `route_policy_access_lists.description` | str |  |  | Description. |
| `route_policy_access_lists.rules` | list | yes |  | Rules. |
| `route_policy_access_lists.rules.number` | int | yes |  | Rule number. |
| `route_policy_access_lists.rules.action` | str | yes |  | Rule action. |
| `route_policy_access_lists.rules.source` | dict |  |  | `{any: true}` or `{network: 10.0.0.0, inverse_mask: 0.0.0.255}` or `{host: 192.0.2.1}`. |
| `route_policy_access_lists.rules.destination` | dict |  |  | Same form as `source`. |

| `route_policy_prefix_lists.rules` | list | yes |  | Rules. |
